mapper.sql: generation_id, job_id, attempt_id, knowledge_id, index_version_id, document_id, document_version_id, manifest_oss_id, manifest_hash, manifest_size, config_hash, source_hash, vector_dimensions, vision_vector_dimensions, chunk_count, dense_count, sparse_count, vision_count, status, cleanup_after, cleaned_at, cleanup_error, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT id, knowledge_id, index_version_id, document_id, document_version_id, generation_id, manifest_hash, chunk_count, member_revision, create_time, update_time FROM knowledge_index_document WHERE index_version_id = #{indexVersionId} AND document_id = #{documentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO knowledge_artifact_generation ( generation_id, job_id, attempt_id, knowledge_id, index_version_id, document_id, document_version_id, manifest_oss_id, manifest_hash, manifest_size, config_hash, source_hash, vector_dimensions, vision_vector_dimensions, chunk_count, vision_count, status, cleanup_after, cleaned_at, cleanup_error, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{generation.generationId}, #{generation.jobId}, #{generation.attemptId}, #{generation.knowledgeId}, #{generation.indexVersionId}, #{generation.documentId}, #{generation.documentVersionId}, #{generation.manifestOssId}, #{generation.manifestHash}, #{generation.manifestSize}, #{generation.configHash}, #{generation.sourceHash}, #{generation.vectorDimensions}, #{generation.visionVectorDimensions}, #{generation.chunkCount}, #{generation.visionCount}, #{generation.status}, #{generation.cleanupAfter}, #{generation.cleanedAt}, #{generation.cleanupError}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_artifact_generation SET dense_count = #{denseCount}, sparse_count = #{sparseCount}, vision_count = #{visionCount}, status = 'READY', cleanup_after = NULL, cleanup_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE generation_id = #{generationId} AND status IN ('UPLOADED', 'READY')

UPDATE knowledge_artifact_generation SET status = 'RETIRED', cleanup_after = #{cleanupAfter}, cleanup_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE generation_id = #{generationId} AND status IN ('UPLOADED', 'READY', 'ORPHANED', 'RETIRED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_index_document d WHERE d.generation_id = knowledge_artifact_generation.generation_id)

UPDATE knowledge_artifact_generation SET status = 'ORPHANED', cleanup_after = #{cleanupAfter}, cleanup_error = #{cleanupError}, update_time = NOW() WHERE generation_id = #{generationId} AND status NOT IN ('CLEANED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_index_document d WHERE d.generation_id = knowledge_artifact_generation.generation_id)
mapper.select: SELECT /* knowledge_periodic_scan */ FROM knowledge_artifact_generation g WHERE g.status IN ('RETIRED', 'ORPHANED') AND g.cleanup_after <= NOW() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_index_document d WHERE d.generation_id = g.generation_id) ORDER BY g.cleanup_after, g.generation_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_index_document WHERE generation_id = #{generationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_artifact_generation SET status = 'VECTOR_CLEANED', cleanup_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE generation_id = #{generationId} AND status IN ('RETIRED', 'ORPHANED', 'VECTOR_CLEANED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_index_document d WHERE d.generation_id = knowledge_artifact_generation.generation_id)

UPDATE knowledge_artifact_generation SET status = 'CLEANED', cleaned_at = NOW(), cleanup_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE generation_id = #{generationId} AND status IN ('VECTOR_CLEANED', 'CLEANED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_index_document d WHERE d.generation_id = knowledge_artifact_generation.generation_id)
UPDATE knowledge_artifact_generation SET cleanup_error = #{cleanupError}, update_time = NOW() WHERE generation_id = #{generationId} AND status = 'VECTOR_CLEANED'
mapper.select: SELECT generation_id FROM knowledge_index_document WHERE index_version_id = #{indexVersionId} UNION SELECT j.generation_id FROM knowledge_parse_job j JOIN knowledge_index_version i ON i.knowledge_id = j.knowledge_id AND i.index_version = j.target_index_version WHERE i.id = #{indexVersionId} AND j.generation_id IS NOT NULL AND j.job_type = 'INGESTION' AND j.status IN ('PENDING','QUEUED','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','CANCEL_REQUESTED')
SELECT generation_id FROM knowledge_index_document WHERE index_version_id = #{indexVersionId} ORDER BY generation_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_index_document WHERE index_version_id = #{indexVersionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_index_document ( id, knowledge_id, index_version_id, document_id, document_version_id, generation_id, manifest_hash, chunk_count, member_revision, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{member.id}, #{member.knowledgeId}, #{member.indexVersionId}, #{member.documentId}, #{member.documentVersionId}, #{member.generationId}, #{member.manifestHash}, #{member.chunkCount}, 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE document_version_id = VALUES(document_version_id), generation_id = VALUES(generation_id), manifest_hash = VALUES(manifest_hash), chunk_count = VALUES(chunk_count), member_revision = member_revision + 1, update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_version i SET i.document_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_index_document d WHERE d.index_version_id = i.id), i.fragment_count = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.chunk_count), 0) FROM knowledge_index_document d WHERE d.index_version_id = i.id), i.update_time = NOW() WHERE i.id = #{indexVersionId}

UPDATE knowledge_index_version i SET i.status = 'READY', i.update_time = NOW() WHERE i.id = #{indexVersionId} AND i.knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND i.status = 'BUILDING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_parse_job j WHERE j.knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND j.target_index_version = i.index_version AND j.job_type != 'REBUILD' AND j.status IN ('PENDING','QUEUED','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','CANCEL_REQUESTED','FAILED') )

UPDATE knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_document_version v ON v.id = #{documentVersionId} JOIN knowledge_index_version i ON i.id = #{indexVersionId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' SET d.current_version_id = v.id, d.current_version_no = v.version_no, d.status = 'READY', d.update_time = NOW() WHERE d.id = #{documentId} AND v.document_id = d.id AND i.knowledge_id = d.knowledge_id AND d.status != 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT k.id AS knowledgeId, k.permission_revision AS permissionRevision, MAX(CAST(k.retrieval_config AS CHAR)) AS retrievalConfig, i.id AS indexVersionId, i.index_version AS indexVersionCode, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(d.member_revision), 0) AS SIGNED) AS manifestRevision, COUNT(d.id) AS memberCount, ( SELECT j.index_snapshot FROM knowledge_parse_job j JOIN knowledge_index_document x ON x.generation_id = j.generation_id WHERE x.index_version_id = i.id AND j.status = #{jobStatus} AND j.index_snapshot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS indexSnapshot FROM knowledge_info k JOIN knowledge_index_version i ON i.knowledge_id = k.id AND i.index_version = k.current_index_version LEFT JOIN knowledge_index_document d ON d.index_version_id = i.id WHERE k.id = #{knowledgeId} AND k.status = #{knowledgeStatus} AND k.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND i.status = #{indexStatus} GROUP BY k.id, k.permission_revision, i.id, i.index_version
mapper.sql: JOIN knowledge_index_version i ON i.id = d.index_version_id JOIN knowledge_info k ON k.id = d.knowledge_id JOIN knowledge_document doc ON doc.id = d.document_id AND doc.knowledge_id = d.knowledge_id AND doc.current_version_id = d.document_version_id JOIN knowledge_document_version v ON v.id = d.document_version_id AND v.document_id = d.document_id AND v.knowledge_id = d.knowledge_id JOIN knowledge_artifact_generation g ON g.generation_id = d.generation_id AND g.index_version_id = d.index_version_id
